_help: Turn methods on/off with "enabled". In "instructions" you can use {ref} (order reference), {amount} and {currency}. "link" is optional; it becomes a Pay button.

methods.name: PayPal (account or card)
methods.instructions: Click the Pay button and send {amount} {currency}. In the note, write your order reference: {ref}.

methods.name: Payoneer / card (payment request)
methods.instructions: Submit your order. Within 24 hours you'll get a Payoneer payment request by email for {amount} {currency}, which you can pay by card or bank. Reference: {ref}.

methods.name: Wise transfer
methods.regions: US, UK, EU, Canada, Japan, Australia and more
methods.instructions: Send {amount} {currency} with Wise to: YOUR NAME, email YOUR-WISE-EMAIL (or the bank details shown in your Wise app). Put {ref} in the reference field.

methods.name: International bank transfer (SWIFT)
methods.regions: Worldwide (your bank may charge a wire fee)
methods.instructions: Bank: Capitec Bank, South Africa. SWIFT/BIC: CABLZAJJ. Account name: YOUR FULL NAME. Account number: YOUR-ACCOUNT-NUMBER. Amount: {amount} {currency}. Reference: {ref}.

methods.name: South African EFT / Capitec Pay
methods.instructions: EFT to Capitec Bank, branch code 470010, account YOUR-ACCOUNT-NUMBER, name YOUR FULL NAME. Pay the rand equivalent of {amount} {currency}. Reference: {ref}.

methods.name: Card payment link (PayFast / Yoco / Paystack)
methods.instructions: Click Pay and pay {amount} {currency} by card. Enter {ref} as the reference if asked.

methods.name: Crypto (USDT / USDC)
methods.instructions: Send {amount} USDT (TRC20) to YOUR-WALLET-ADDRESS. After paying, paste the transaction ID below.
